title: CSAA Fellowship (Certified Shari'ah Advisor and Auditor)
body: Accounting and Auditing Organization for Islamic Financial Institutions (AAOIFI)
source: AAOIFI CSAA Revamped Modular Fellowship Framework
summary: AAOIFI's flagship Islamic finance fellowship qualification: Module 1 CPSS (60+ Shari'ah Standards across commercial contracts) and Module 2 CPAAGE (Audit, Governance, and Ethics) with 1 year verified PER and direct CIPA fast-track articulation.

standard.name: Modular Fellowship Pathway
standard.blurb: Complete the two modular curriculum certifications (CPSS & CPAAGE), sit the modular exams (70% pass), and complete 1 year of verified practical experience.

stages.title: Stage 1: Module 1 — Shari'ah Standards Mastery (CPSS)
stages.subtitle: Core AAOIFI Shari'ah Standards across commercial contracts and Islamic capital markets

nodes.name: Shari'ah Fundamentals & Commercial Prohibitions
nodes.description: Islamic jurisprudence (Fiqh al-Mu'amalat), prohibition of Riba (interest), Gharar (excessive ambiguity), Maysir (gambling), and rules of Qabd (possession).
topics: Foundations of Islamic Jurisprudence & Maqasid al-Shari'ah
Riba al-Fadl vs Riba al-Nasi'ah: Prohibitions & Modern Banking Implications
Gharar in Derivative Contracts & Speculative Trading
Rules of Constructive and Physical Possession (Qabd al-Haqiqi wa al-Hukmi)

nodes.name: Financing & Exchange Contracts
nodes.description: Murabahah to purchase orderer (SS 8), Salam and Parallel Salam (SS 10), Istisna'a (SS 11), Tawarruq monetization (SS 30), and Sarf currency exchange (SS 1).
topics: Murabahah to the Purchase Orderer (SS 8): Agency, Risk Bearing & Default Penalties
Salam & Parallel Salam (SS 10): Agricultural and Commodity Pre-Financing
Istisna'a & Parallel Istisna'a (SS 11): Manufacturing & Infrastructure Projects
Organized Tawarruq (SS 30) Rules and Regulatory Shari'ah Constraints

nodes.name: Leasing, Services & Equity Partnerships
nodes.description: Ijarah and Ijarah Muntahia Bittamleek (SS 9), Musharakah and Diminishing Musharakah (SS 12), Mudarabah fund management (SS 13), and Wakalah agencies (SS 23).
topics: Ijarah Operating Leases vs Ijarah Muntahia Bittamleek Financial Leases (SS 9)
Mudarabah Profit-Sharing Partnerships & Capital Loss Allocations (SS 13)
Diminishing Musharakah in Home and Asset Financing (SS 12)
Wakalah bi al-Istithmar Investment Agencies (SS 23)

nodes.name: Capital Markets, Sukuk & Social Finance
nodes.description: Investment Sukuk issuance and securitization (SS 17), Takaful and Retakaful solidarity insurance (SS 26), Zakah computation (SS 35), and Waqf endowments (SS 33).
topics: Investment Sukuk (SS 17): Asset-Backed vs Asset-Based Structuring & Guarantees
Takaful Models: Wakalah vs Waqf-Wakalah Insurance Structures (SS 26)
Corporate Zakah Calculation Methodologies for IFIs (SS 35)
Waqf Endowments and Modern Socio-Financial Applications (SS 33)

nodes.name: CPSS Modular Examination
nodes.description: Computer-based modular exam evaluating technical mastery across all 60+ AAOIFI Shari'ah Standards. Passing score: 70%.
checklists: Achieve $\ge$ 70% passing threshold on computer-based exam

stages.title: Stage 2: Module 2 — Governance, Audit & Ethics (CPAAGE)
stages.subtitle: Internal/external Shari'ah audit, governance standards, and AAOIFI ethics

nodes.name: Shari'ah Governance & Supervisory Boards
nodes.description: Shari'ah Supervisory Board (SSB) mandate, independence, fatwa issuance, appointment, and oversight under AAOIFI Governance Standards (GS 1, GS 2, GS 4, GS 5/7).
topics: SSB Composition, Independence, and Fiduciary Mandate (GS 1 & GS 2)
Audit and Governance Committee Relations (GS 4)
Corporate Social Responsibility and Code of Conduct (GS 7)

nodes.name: Internal Shari'ah Review & Risk Management
nodes.description: Internal Shari'ah Audit Department (ISAD) charter, risk-based audit programs, compliance monitoring, Shari'ah non-compliance risk (SNCR), and income purification.
topics: Internal Shari'ah Review Execution and Charter (GS 3 & GS 11)
Shari'ah Non-Compliance Risk (SNCR) Identification & Management
Tainting of Transactions and Charity Fund Purification Procedures

nodes.name: External Auditing & Assurance for IFIs
nodes.description: Auditing Standards for Islamic Financial Institutions (ASIFI 1, 2, 3, 5), external Shari'ah audit opinions, profit-sharing investment accounts (PSIA), and reserves (PER/IRR).
topics: Objective and Principles of Auditing for IFIs (ASIFI 1)
The Auditor's Report and Shari'ah Compliance Statements (ASIFI 2)
Testing Profit Equalization Reserves (PER) and Investment Risk Reserves (IRR)

nodes.name: Professional Ethics for Islamic Finance
nodes.description: AAOIFI Code of Ethics for Accountants and Auditors of IFIs: trustworthiness (Amanah), truthfulness, integrity, professional competence, and confidentiality.
topics: AAOIFI Code of Ethics Core Principles (Amanah, Sidq, Ikhlas)
Ethical Dilemmas in Islamic Banking Practices and Board Pressures

nodes.name: CPAAGE Modular Examination
nodes.description: Modular examination covering governance, internal and external Shari'ah audit, and ethics. Passing score: 70%.
checklists: Review AAOIFI Governance and Auditing Standards
Achieve $\ge$ 70% passing threshold on computer-based exam

stages.title: Stage 3: Practical Experience & Fellowship Induction
stages.subtitle: 1 Year verified experience and fellowship conferral

nodes.name: 1 Year Verified Practical Experience in IFI
nodes.description: Document at least 1 year of practical work experience in Shari'ah compliance, internal Shari'ah audit, Islamic banking operations, or external audit of IFIs.
topics: Practical Experience in Islamic Finance
Workplace Competency Verification

nodes.name: CSAA Fellowship Conferred
nodes.description: Formal award of the CSAA Fellowship by AAOIFI. Qualifies charterholder for fast-track articulation into the Certified Islamic Professional Accountant (CIPA) program.
topics: Full CSAA Fellowship Award
Right to use CSAA designation
CIPA Exemption Articulation: Holders receive automatic exemptions in CIPA Governance and Ethics papers
resources: AAOIFI Certified Shari'ah Advisor and Auditor Fellowship Registry
